name: read-claude-code-history
description: >- Reads, searches and exports local Claude Code history without resuming work: session inventory, timelines, verbatim user input, keyword or fuzzy recall, and recovering files from transcripts. Use when the user asks what was said, wants a session ID or original context, or needs proof of what a session contained. Not for Codex (use read-codex-history); with no platform named, start at local-conversation-history.
author: daymade
